title: Revit governed parameter identity and binding
test_intent: Determine whether governed Revit parameters resolve to the central registry identity and whether their instance/type behavior and category binding match the applicable governed definition.

applicability.applies_when: The tested Revit model contains parameters governed by S8 and the central Shared Parameter Registry.
applicability.not_applicable_when: No governed parameter applies to the tested model or tested category scope.

required_evidence: applicable central registry rows including GUID, name, data definition, status, and governed binding data where available
Revit parameter inventory including GUID/name/data type
observed instance/type behavior and category binding
approved exceptions or unresolved binding records where applicable

result_logic.pass: Every applicable governed parameter matches the central identity and all available governed behavior/binding rules, with no conflicting or broader unauthorized binding.
result_logic.fail: An applicable governed parameter has a conflicting GUID/name/data definition or violates an available governed instance/type/category binding rule.
result_logic.not_applicable: No governed parameter applies to the tested scope.
result_logic.indeterminate: Registry identity or governed binding/category data required for evaluation is unavailable or explicitly unresolved.

provenance.migration_note: Appendix E ATS extends the existing S8 identity pilot into Revit-specific binding and behavior without inventing missing binding data.
